svg.desc: GitHub contribution calendar from Nov 9, 2025 to Nov 14, 2026: 1,725 contributions across 186 active days. An animated snake travels the calendar grid and eats each day that has contributions, then the calendar regrows and the loop repeats.
svg.text: 1,725 contributions in the last year · the snake eats every active day, rebuilt from live GitHub data.
